goal: Prevent depends builds sharing a source directory from silently building from the wrong local source files
Stop separate Git worktrees from overwriting or reusing each other's local package tarballs
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Confirms code changes look right and match the fix from issue 35764 (ryanofsky)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it prevents silent build corruption when multiple checkouts share a common source path
Ensures worktrees do not reuse stale local package tarballs from other checkouts
